shape: 4-portal cross arena (N + S + W + E gates) with central clique
description: Four-portal arena with a central clique. NW cluster (pve0h8 west entry + gsii78 + yflz9o + zy1jw1) forms a 4-anchor clique on the west/center. yflz9o (3-way) bridges spawn_north + pve0h8 + zy1jw1. SE cluster (luvykz south entry + 1skjqw + zy1jw1) is a triangle. The center anchor (zy1jw1) is a 4-way: pve0h8 + yflz9o + 1skjqw + luvykz. East column: 1skjqw → 6zqmrh → spawn_east (2-hop east chain).

portals.north: spawn_north at (-9.38, -4.19) — gate on the north (low-Z) side
portals.south: spawn_south at (16.98, 17.46) — gate on the south (high-Z) side
portals.west: spawn_west at (-23.11, 17.35) — gate on the west (low-X) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.28, -14.15) — gate on the east (high-X) side

traversalNotes: Direct N→S: spawn_north → north_inner → center → south_inner → spawn_south. 4 hops.
Direct N→W: spawn_north → north_inner → west_inner → spawn_west. 3 hops.
Direct N→E: spawn_north → north_inner → center → se_step → east_inner → spawn_east. 5 hops.
Direct W→S: spawn_west → west_inner → center → south_inner → spawn_south. 4 hops.
Direct W→E: spawn_west → west_inner → center → se_step → east_inner → spawn_east. 5 hops.
Direct S→E: spawn_south → south_inner → se_step → east_inner → spawn_east. 4 hops.
DISPATCH: center (zy1jw1) is the 4-way central router; north_inner and south_inner are 3-way gate dispatchers.
nw_pocket is a 1-degree dead-end off west_inner.
SE TRIANGLE: south_inner + center + se_step — BFS picks the shorter side.
